global_prompt: Router assistant transcript. Enable guest Wi-Fi and turn off the guest network. Limit the phone to 50 Mbps and set the laptop bandwidth to 20 Mbps. Optimize gaming for the PC, boost YouTube, and prioritize Netflix for the smart TV. Prioritize gaming traffic. Block TikTok on the tablet. Prevent gaming on the laptop. Unblock YouTube for the tablet. Unblock internet access. Check the router status, gateway information, and router uptime. Check internet connection quality and open the QoS page. Show the active gaming sessions. Which devices are playing games. Which clients are connected right now. Show all online devices. Show device info for the tablet. Get the connection details for my phone. Restore Wi-Fi access. Block internet for the phone. Check the IP and status of the router.

scenarios.name: Network information
scenarios.prompt: How is the network today? Check the internet connection quality. Is the Wi-Fi stable? What is my network status?
examples: Tell me the current network condition.

scenarios.name: Router information
scenarios.prompt: Check the router status. Show my gateway information. What is the router uptime?
examples: Tell me how the router is doing.

scenarios.name: Wi-Fi device details
scenarios.prompt: Show device info for the tablet. Get the connection details for my phone. What are the IP and status of the laptop?
examples: Show device info for the tablet.
Get the connection details for my phone.
What are the IP and status of the laptop?
Show Wi-Fi device info for my son's phone.
Give me the Wi-Fi details for Alice.
What device is my son using?

scenarios.name: Online devices
scenarios.prompt: Which clients are connected right now? Show all online devices. List the devices currently using Wi-Fi.
examples: Which clients are connected right now?
List the devices currently using Wi-Fi.
What is connected to my Wi-Fi?

scenarios.name: Active sessions
scenarios.prompt: Show the active gaming sessions. Which devices are playing games? Who is gaming right now?
examples: Who is gaming, video, or call right now?

scenarios.name: Guest Wi-Fi
scenarios.prompt: Enable guest Wi-Fi. Turn off the guest network. Please turn the guest Wi-Fi on.
examples: Please turn the guest Wi-Fi on.

scenarios.name: Optimize an app
scenarios.prompt: Prioritize Netflix for the smart TV. Prioritize gaming for the PC. Optimize gaming for the PC. Boost YouTube on my laptop. Open the QoS page.
examples: Prioritize Netflix for the smart TV.
Show what each device is doing.

scenarios.name: Bandwidth limit
scenarios.prompt: Limit the phone to 50 Mbps. Set the laptop bandwidth to 20 Mbps. Cap the tablet at 10 Mbps (megabits per second). Set bandwidth to 100 Mbps.
examples: Set the laptop bandwidth to 20 Mbps.
Cap the tablet at 10 megabits per second.
Set my son's phone bandwidth to 20 Mbps.
Put a bandwidth limit of 50 Mbps on John's laptop.

scenarios.name: Block internet access
scenarios.prompt: Block internet for the tablet. Cut off Wi-Fi for my son's phone. Disable internet access on the guest laptop.
examples: Cut off Wi-Fi for my son's phone.
Disable internet access on the guest laptop.
Turn off internet access for John's laptop.
Cut off the tablet's internet access.

scenarios.name: Unblock internet access
scenarios.prompt: Unblock internet for the tablet. Restore Wi-Fi access to my phone. Let the laptop connect to the internet again.
examples: Restore Wi-Fi access to my phone.
Let the laptop connect to the internet again.
Reconnect my son's phone to the internet.

scenarios.name: Block an app
scenarios.prompt: Prevent gaming on the laptop. Block YouTube for the tablet. Stop TikTok on my child's phone.
examples: Stop TikTok on my child's phone.
Do not allow YouTube on the smart TV.

scenarios.name: Unblock an app
scenarios.prompt: Unblock YouTube for the tablet. Unblock TikTok on my phone. Allow TikTok on my phone again. Remove blocking gaming from the laptop.
examples: Allow TikTok on my phone again.
Remove blocking gaming from the laptop.
Turn Netflix back on for the living room TV.
Let the tablet use YouTube again.
